g.text: Waiting times from an exponential distribution with mean 2 and SD 2 (very skewed)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: LLN: the sample mean gets close to μ. CLT: its random error looks more and more like a normal curve with SD σ/√n.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: The raw data stay skewed. There is no magic n = 30: the more skewed the data, the larger n must be.
